simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to תֹּקֶף (H8633) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: תֹּקֶף (tôqeph) means might or (figuratively) positiveness First listed occurrence: Dan 11 17.

definitions.full: H8633. toqeph תֹּ֫קֶף noun masculine power, strength, energy (Aramaic תֹּקֶף תְּקוֺף, ); — ׳ת absolute Est 9:29 ; construct Dan 11:17 , the strength of his whole kingdom ; suffix תָּקְמּוֺ Est 10:2 the deeds of his power (+ גְּבוּרָתוֺ , etc.).
